deck.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D game foreground environment, wide landscape 1536x1024. Input image 1 is a STYLE AND MATERIAL reference only (existing storm deck). Create a new elevated side view of the broad WALKABLE DECK of Odysseus's ancient Greek wooden ship for a 2.5D action minigame. Wet dark warm timber, bronze fittings, red Greek decorative accents, painterly detailed pixel-art matching reference. Composition CRITICAL: EMPTY TRANSPARENT sky/sea region across the upper 40% of canvas, no painted sea or sky. A low rear railing runs horizontally at y=40%; walkable floor fills y=43% through bottom edge, wide open and uncluttered. A single main mast at x=50% rises from its base at y=65% through the top edge, a coil of rope around its base; a sturdy tiller/steering oar mount on the far left at x=13%, y=68%; one low broken crate on far right at x=88%, y=68%. Sparse ropes along edges only. Open walkable route both in front and behind mast base. Ship continues beyond left, right, and bottom edges so floor fills entire lower canvas. Consistent elevated camera perspective with floor clearly visible. No people, no bag, no ships in background, no UI, no lettering, no labels, no watermark. Preserve genuinely transparent alpha above railing and between rigging. The deck is the only opaque foreground. This must serve as a playable background, not an illustration with actors.

actor.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D character animation sprite atlas with transparent background, landscape 1536x1024, EXACT 4 columns by 3 rows of evenly separated cells. Input image 1 is the CANONICAL ODYSSEUS identity and costume reference; input image 2 is the wind BAG object reference. Render the SAME mature Greek captain in every cell: medium-long wavy dark brown hair, natural proportionate nose, neat full dark beard, bronze owl breastplate, dark navy leather skirt, red cloak with gold circular clasps, bronze greaves and sandals. Do NOT use blue cape or cream skirt, no helmet, no sword, no missing teeth. Match painterly detailed pixel-art of reference. Slight elevated side camera suitable for a broad ship deck; face RIGHT in every walking frame. All frames use the exact same scale and feet baseline near 90% cell height, full body with generous transparent gutters. ROW 1 (4 cells): four genuinely DIFFERENT phases of a rightward walking cycle, left foot forward/contact, down/passing, right foot forward/contact, up/passing; arms counter-swing, cloak follows, consistent identity. ROW 2 (4 cells): same four rightward walking phases, now carrying the SMALL tied golden/teal wind bag firmly against torso with both hands; bag is around one quarter body height, not oversized. ROW 3 (4 cells left to right): 1 strong braced crouch reaching outward to grip a nearby rope, 2 kneeling and reaching down to untie tangled cords, 3 staggered low one-knee knockdown shielding face from water, 4 standing planted feet opening the bag held forward/right, gold/teal bag recognizable, no painted wind effects. One single isolated Odysseus per cell. No extra people, no scenery, no ground, no shadows outside silhouettes, no contact-sheet labels, no letters, no watermark. Genuine transparent alpha.
